### Fixed
- **The agent-readiness write map now sees HubSpot's newer AI workflow actions.**
  Actions such as "Fill Smart Property", phone validation and ticket copy name the
  field they write using a different convention than the classic workflow actions,
  so the properties they wrote were missing from the collision map, with no warning
  that anything had been skipped. A report could therefore call a field clear when a
  workflow was already writing it. Those writes are now counted, including actions
  that write several fields at once. Fields a workflow only *reads* are still
  excluded, so nothing is over-reported.
